id.title: Wajah Pertama
id.summary: Dekatkan wajah Anda, lalu biarkan bayi menatap dan mengenali Anda.
id.learning_goal: Bayi belajar mengenali wajah pengasuhnya dan merasa aman karena ditanggapi.

steps.title: Cari posisi nyaman
steps.body: Gendong bayi atau baringkan di pangkuan Anda, dengan wajah Anda sekitar 25-30 cm dari wajahnya. Itu jarak pandang paling jelas untuk bayi baru.

steps.title: Tatap dan diam dulu
steps.body: Tatap matanya tanpa bicara selama beberapa detik. Beri waktu bayi untuk fokus.

steps.title: Sapa dengan suara rendah
steps.body: Katakan namanya dengan pelan: "Hai, Nak." Suara rendah dan lambat lebih mudah ditangkap bayi.

steps.title: Tunggu balasannya
steps.body: Perhatikan apakah ia mengerjap, menggerakkan mulut, atau menatap lebih lama. Itu balasan. Tanggapi dengan senyum.

steps.title: Berhenti saat ia memalingkan muka
steps.body: Bayi memalingkan wajah ketika sudah cukup. Hentikan, dan peluk saja.

id.parent_tip: Anda tidak perlu bicara banyak. Hadir dan menanggapi sudah cukup. Lima detik tatapan yang hangat lebih berarti daripada lima menit bicara.
id.safety_notes: Selalu topang kepala dan leher bayi. Jangan lakukan saat bayi sedang menangis kuat atau sangat lapar.
variations: Lakukan saat mengganti baju, posisi bayi sudah terlentang dan wajah Anda di atasnya.
Ganti suara menjadi humming pelan tanpa kata.

en.title: First Face
en.summary: Bring your face close and let your baby look at you and learn you.
en.learning_goal: Your baby learns to recognise their caregiver's face and feels safe because you respond.

steps.title: Get comfortable
steps.body: Hold your baby or lay them on your lap, with your face about 25-30 cm from theirs. That is the clearest focal distance for a newborn.

steps.title: Look, and stay quiet
steps.body: Hold their gaze without speaking for a few seconds. Give them time to focus.

steps.title: Greet them low and slow
steps.body: Say their name softly: "Hello, little one." A low, slow voice is easier for a baby to take in.

steps.title: Wait for their answer
steps.body: Watch for a blink, a mouth movement, or a longer stare. That is their answer. Answer back with a smile.

steps.title: Stop when they look away
steps.body: Babies turn their face away when they have had enough. Stop there, and just hold them.

en.parent_tip: You don't need many words. Being present and responding is enough. Five seconds of warm eye contact matters more than five minutes of talking.
en.safety_notes: Always support your baby's head and neck. Skip this while they are crying hard or very hungry.
variations: Do it during a nappy change, when they are already on their back and your face is above them.
Swap words for quiet humming.

id.title: Tummy Time Singkat
id.summary: Tiga menit tengkurap sambil Anda temani dari depan.
id.learning_goal: Memperkuat otot leher, punggung, dan bahu yang nanti dipakai untuk duduk.

steps.title: Pilih waktu yang tepat
steps.body: Lakukan saat bayi bangun, tenang, dan tidak baru saja menyusu. Minimal 30 menit setelah menyusu.

steps.title: Bentangkan selimut
steps.body: Gelar selimut tipis di lantai yang rata. Lantai lebih baik daripada kasur karena permukaannya tidak melesak.

steps.title: Baringkan tengkurap
steps.body: Letakkan bayi tengkurap, tangan di depan dada. Anda ikut berbaring di depannya, wajah sejajar.

steps.title: Panggil namanya
steps.body: Ajak bicara dari depan supaya ia terdorong mengangkat kepala untuk mencari Anda.

steps.title: Berhenti sebelum ia lelah
steps.body: Satu sampai tiga menit sudah cukup di awal. Angkat sebelum ia mulai rewel, agar pengalamannya tetap menyenangkan.

id.parent_tip: Sering tapi singkat lebih baik daripada sekali tapi lama. Dua sampai tiga kali sehari, masing-masing beberapa menit.
id.safety_notes: Jangan pernah tinggalkan bayi tengkurap tanpa pengawasan, dan jangan lakukan saat bayi mengantuk. Tidur harus selalu dalam posisi telentang.
variations: Tengkurapkan bayi di atas dada Anda saat Anda setengah berbaring. Lebih mudah untuk bayi yang belum suka lantai.
Letakkan cermin aman di depannya supaya ada yang dilihat.
id.materials_text: Selimut tipis dan lantai yang rata

en.title: Short Tummy Time
en.summary: Three minutes on their tummy while you lie down in front of them.
en.learning_goal: Builds the neck, back and shoulder muscles they will later use to sit up.

steps.title: Pick the right moment
steps.body: Do this while your baby is awake, calm, and not just fed. Wait at least 30 minutes after a feed.

steps.title: Lay out a blanket
steps.body: Spread a thin blanket on a flat floor. The floor is better than a bed because it doesn't sink.

steps.title: Place them on their tummy
steps.body: Put your baby face down with their hands in front of their chest. Lie down in front of them, face at their level.

steps.title: Call their name
steps.body: Talk to them from the front so they are drawn to lift their head and find you.

steps.title: Stop before they tire
steps.body: One to three minutes is plenty at first. Pick them up before they start fussing, so the experience stays a good one.

en.parent_tip: Often and short beats once and long. Two or three times a day, a few minutes each.
en.safety_notes: Never leave a baby on their tummy unsupervised, and don't do this when they are sleepy. Sleep is always on the back.
variations: Lay them on your chest while you half recline. Easier for a baby who doesn't like the floor yet.
Put a safe mirror in front of them so there is something to look at.
en.materials_text: A thin blanket and a flat floor

id.title: Balas Ocehannya
id.summary: Setiap suara yang keluar dari bayi, balas seolah ia sedang bicara.
id.learning_goal: Bayi belajar bahwa suaranya didengar dan membuat orang lain menanggapi. Ini dasar percakapan.

steps.title: Dengarkan dulu
steps.body: Tunggu sampai bayi mengeluarkan suara apa pun: "aah", "ngg", atau sekadar embusan napas.

steps.title: Tirukan suaranya
steps.body: Ulangi bunyi yang sama persis, dengan nada hangat. Kalau ia bilang "aah", Anda juga bilang "aah".

steps.title: Beri jeda
steps.body: Diam dan tunggu tiga sampai lima detik. Jeda inilah yang mengajarkan bergiliran.

steps.title: Tambahkan satu kata
steps.body: Setelah menirukan, sambung dengan kalimat pendek: "Oh ya? Cerita lagi."

steps.title: Ulangi selama ia mau
steps.body: Lanjutkan selama bayi masih menatap dan bersuara. Berhenti saat ia memalingkan wajah.

id.parent_tip: Jeda adalah bagian terpenting. Banyak orang tua bicara terus dan tidak memberi bayi kesempatan membalas.
id.safety_notes: Tidak ada risiko khusus. Pastikan posisi gendong aman dan kepala tertopang.
variations: Lakukan saat menyusui atau memberi susu, saat jarak wajah sudah dekat.
Gunakan nada tinggi-rendah bergantian untuk melihat mana yang lebih menarik perhatiannya.

en.title: Answer Their Babble
en.summary: Treat every sound your baby makes as their turn to speak, and answer it.
en.learning_goal: Your baby learns that their voice is heard and makes others respond. This is the foundation of conversation.

steps.title: Listen first
steps.body: Wait until your baby makes any sound at all: "aah", "ngg", or just a puff of breath.

steps.title: Copy the sound
steps.body: Repeat exactly the same sound, warmly. If they say "aah", you say "aah".

steps.title: Leave a pause
steps.body: Go quiet and wait three to five seconds. The pause is what teaches turn-taking.

steps.title: Add one line
steps.body: After copying, follow with something short: "Oh really? Tell me more."

steps.title: Keep going while they want to
steps.body: Carry on as long as they are still looking and making sounds. Stop when they turn away.

en.parent_tip: The pause is the most important part. Many parents keep talking and never leave the baby room to answer.
en.safety_notes: No particular risk. Just make sure your hold is secure and their head is supported.
variations: Do it during a feed, when your faces are already close.
Alternate high and low pitch to see which holds their attention better.

id.title: Ikuti Kain Pelan
id.summary: Gerakkan kain bermotif kontras dengan sangat lambat, dan biarkan mata bayi mengikutinya.
id.learning_goal: Melatih mata mengikuti benda bergerak, yang nanti dipakai untuk meraih dan membaca.

steps.title: Pilih kain kontras
steps.body: Ambil kain dengan pola hitam-putih atau warna sangat kontras. Bayi baru paling peka pada kontras tinggi, bukan warna pastel.

steps.title: Baringkan bayi telentang
steps.body: Letakkan bayi telentang di permukaan rata, dan duduk di sebelahnya.

steps.title: Pegang kain di tengah pandangannya
steps.body: Tahan kain sekitar 25 cm di atas wajahnya sampai matanya benar-benar fokus ke kain.

steps.title: Gerakkan sangat lambat
steps.body: Pindahkan kain ke kanan sejauh sekitar 15 cm, dengan hitungan tiga. Terlalu cepat dan matanya akan kehilangan jejak.

steps.title: Kembali dan ganti arah
steps.body: Bawa kembali ke tengah, lalu ke kiri. Tiga kali bolak-balik sudah cukup.

id.parent_tip: Kalau matanya tidak mengikuti, bukan berarti ada masalah. Bayi di bawah dua bulan sering baru bisa fokus sebentar. Coba lagi besok.
id.safety_notes: Jaga kain tidak menyentuh atau menutupi wajah bayi. Jangan gunakan kain berbulu halus yang bisa terhirup.
variations: Pakai wajah Anda sendiri sebagai benda yang diikuti.
Gerakkan dari bawah ke atas untuk variasi arah.
id.materials_text: Satu kain bersih dengan pola kontras

en.title: Follow The Slow Cloth
en.summary: Move a high-contrast cloth very slowly and let your baby's eyes track it.
en.learning_goal: Trains the eyes to follow a moving object, which they will later use to reach and to read.

steps.title: Choose a high-contrast cloth
steps.body: Pick a cloth with a black-and-white or strongly contrasting pattern. Newborns see contrast far better than pastel colour.

steps.title: Lay your baby on their back
steps.body: Put them on their back on a flat surface and sit beside them.

steps.title: Hold the cloth in their line of sight
steps.body: Hold it about 25 cm above their face until their eyes properly settle on it.

steps.title: Move it very slowly
steps.body: Shift the cloth about 15 cm to the right over a slow count of three. Any faster and their eyes lose it.

steps.title: Come back, then switch sides
steps.body: Bring it back to the middle, then over to the left. Three passes each way is plenty.

en.parent_tip: If their eyes don't follow, nothing is wrong. Babies under two months often focus only briefly. Try again tomorrow.
en.safety_notes: Keep the cloth from touching or covering your baby's face. Avoid fluffy fabrics that shed fibres.
variations: Use your own face as the thing they follow.
Move it bottom to top for a different direction.
en.materials_text: One clean cloth with a contrasting pattern

id.title: Cari Suara Lembut
id.summary: Bersuara dari sisi kanan, lalu kiri, dan lihat apakah bayi menoleh mencari asal suara.
id.learning_goal: Melatih bayi menghubungkan suara dengan arah, dasar dari mendengarkan dan nanti berbahasa.

steps.title: Pastikan ruangan tenang
steps.body: Matikan televisi dan musik. Suara latar membuat bayi sulit memisahkan suara Anda.

steps.title: Baringkan bayi telentang
steps.body: Posisikan bayi telentang agar kepalanya bebas bergerak ke dua arah.

steps.title: Bersuara dari kanan
steps.body: Dari sekitar 20 cm di samping kanan telinganya, bersuara pelan: "sss" atau namanya. Jangan terlalu dekat.

steps.title: Beri waktu menoleh
steps.body: Tunggu lima detik. Bayi baru butuh waktu untuk memproses dan bergerak.

steps.title: Pindah ke sisi kiri
steps.body: Ulangi dari sisi kiri. Dua kali per sisi cukup.

id.parent_tip: Bayi sering merespons dengan diam dan membuka mata lebih lebar, bukan dengan menoleh. Itu juga respons.
id.safety_notes: Jangan bersuara keras atau tiba-tiba di dekat telinga bayi. Suara yang nyaman untuk Anda bisa terlalu kuat untuknya.
variations: Gunakan bunyi gesekan kain alih-alih suara mulut.
Lakukan sambil bayi digendong tegak di bahu Anda.

en.title: Find The Soft Sound
en.summary: Make a soft sound to their right, then their left, and see if they turn towards it.
en.learning_goal: Teaches your baby to link sound with direction, the basis of listening and later of language.

steps.title: Make the room quiet
steps.body: Turn off the TV and any music. Background noise makes it hard for a baby to pick your voice out.

steps.title: Lay your baby on their back
steps.body: On their back, their head is free to turn either way.

steps.title: Make a sound on the right
steps.body: From about 20 cm to the right of their ear, make a soft sound: "sss" or their name. Not too close.

steps.title: Give them time to turn
steps.body: Wait five seconds. Newborns need time to process and then move.

steps.title: Switch to the left
steps.body: Repeat on the left side. Twice per side is enough.

en.parent_tip: Babies often respond by going still and opening their eyes wider rather than turning. That is a response too.
en.safety_notes: Never make a loud or sudden sound near a baby's ear. A volume that is comfortable for you can be too much for them.
variations: Use the rustle of a cloth instead of your voice.
Try it while holding them upright against your shoulder.

id.title: Senyum dan Balas Senyum
id.summary: Tersenyum lebar, tunggu, dan rayakan ketika bayi mulai membalas.
id.learning_goal: Membangun senyum sosial, tanda awal bahwa bayi berinteraksi dengan sengaja.

steps.title: Pilih saat ia paling segar
steps.body: Biasanya setelah tidur dan setelah kenyang. Bayi yang lelah tidak akan membalas.

steps.title: Dekatkan wajah dan tersenyum lebar
steps.body: Senyum yang jelas, mata ikut tersenyum. Bayi membaca seluruh wajah, bukan hanya mulut.

steps.title: Tahan senyum itu
steps.body: Jangan langsung ganti ekspresi. Tahan lima sampai sepuluh detik.

steps.title: Rayakan percobaan sekecil apa pun
steps.body: Sudut mulut yang naik sedikit sudah cukup. Tanggapi dengan suara senang: "Iya! Kamu senyum."

steps.title: Ulang tiga sampai empat kali
steps.body: Beri jeda di antaranya. Senyum sosial biasanya muncul sekitar usia enam sampai delapan minggu.

id.parent_tip: Kalau belum ada balasan sampai usia tiga bulan, catat dan tanyakan pada dokter atau bidan saat kontrol rutin. Jangan diagnosis sendiri.
variations: Tambahkan bunyi kecil setiap kali tersenyum, agar ada dua isyarat sekaligus.
Lakukan di depan cermin sambil bayi digendong.

en.title: Smile And Smile Back
en.summary: Smile widely, wait, and celebrate the moment your baby starts smiling back.
en.learning_goal: Builds the social smile, the first sign that your baby is interacting on purpose.

steps.title: Pick their freshest moment
steps.body: Usually after a nap and after a feed. A tired baby won't answer.

steps.title: Come close and smile widely
steps.body: A clear smile, with your eyes in it too. Babies read the whole face, not just the mouth.

steps.title: Hold the smile
steps.body: Don't change expression right away. Hold it for five to ten seconds.

steps.title: Celebrate the smallest attempt
steps.body: A corner of the mouth lifting is enough. Answer with a pleased voice: "Yes! You smiled."

steps.title: Repeat three or four times
steps.body: Pause in between. The social smile usually appears around six to eight weeks.

en.parent_tip: If there is no smile back by three months, make a note and raise it at your next check-up. Don't diagnose it yourself.
variations: Add a small sound each time you smile, so there are two cues at once.
Try it in front of a mirror while holding them.

id.title: Ngobrol Saat Ganti Baju
id.summary: Ubah ganti baju atau ganti diaper menjadi waktu bicara, bukan sekadar tugas.
id.learning_goal: Menyelipkan bahasa dan kedekatan ke dalam rutinitas yang sudah pasti terjadi setiap hari.

steps.title: Umumkan apa yang akan terjadi
steps.body: Sebelum mulai, katakan: "Kita ganti baju, ya." Bayi belajar bahwa ada yang akan terjadi padanya.

steps.title: Sebut nama bagian tubuh
steps.body: Saat memasukkan tangan ke lengan baju, katakan "tangan kanan". Lakukan pelan supaya kata dan gerakan sinkron.

steps.title: Beri jeda sebelum setiap gerakan
steps.body: Tunggu satu detik sebelum mengangkat kaki atau memutar badannya. Jeda membuat bayi tidak terkejut.

steps.title: Tanggapi suaranya
steps.body: Kalau ia bersuara di tengah proses, jawab. Ini percakapan, bukan monolog.

steps.title: Tutup dengan sentuhan
steps.body: Selesai berpakaian, usap perut atau pipinya sebentar sebagai penutup.

id.parent_tip: Rutinitas terjadi puluhan kali seminggu. Mengubahnya menjadi waktu bicara jauh lebih mudah daripada mencari waktu khusus.
id.safety_notes: Jangan pernah tinggalkan bayi di meja ganti tanpa satu tangan memegangnya, bahkan sedetik.
variations: Lakukan hal yang sama saat memandikan.
Nyanyikan satu lagu pendek yang sama setiap ganti baju, agar jadi penanda rutinitas.

en.title: Talk Through Getting Dressed
en.summary: Turn a nappy or clothes change into talking time rather than just a task.
en.learning_goal: Slips language and closeness into a routine that is already going to happen every day.

steps.title: Say what is about to happen
steps.body: Before you start: "We're getting dressed now." Your baby learns that something is coming.

steps.title: Name body parts
steps.body: As you guide an arm into a sleeve, say "right arm". Go slowly so the word and the movement line up.

steps.title: Pause before each move
steps.body: Wait a second before lifting a leg or turning them over. The pause keeps it from being startling.

steps.title: Answer their sounds
steps.body: If they make a noise partway through, answer it. This is a conversation, not a monologue.

steps.title: Close with a touch
steps.body: Once dressed, stroke their tummy or cheek for a moment to mark the end.

en.parent_tip: Routines happen dozens of times a week. Turning one into talking time is far easier than finding a separate slot.
en.safety_notes: Never leave a baby on a changing table without one hand on them, not even for a second.
variations: Do the same thing at bath time.
Sing the same short song at every change, so it becomes the signal for this routine.

id.title: Kain Tekstur Aman
id.summary: Sentuhkan dua atau tiga jenis kain ke tangan dan kaki bayi, satu per satu.
id.learning_goal: Mengenalkan perbedaan tekstur melalui kulit, pintu masuk pertama bayi memahami dunia benda.

steps.title: Siapkan dua atau tiga kain
steps.body: Pilih yang jelas berbeda: kain katun halus, handuk kasar, dan kain bermotif rajut. Pastikan semuanya bersih.

steps.title: Mulai dari tangan
steps.body: Usapkan kain pertama ke punggung tangannya dengan lembut, sambil menyebut: "halus".

steps.title: Beri waktu merasakan
steps.body: Tahan beberapa detik di satu tempat sebelum berpindah. Bayi butuh waktu memproses sentuhan.

steps.title: Ganti ke kain berbeda
steps.body: Gunakan kain kedua di tangan yang sama, dan beri nama berbeda: "kasar". Perbedaan yang berurutan paling mudah dirasakan.

steps.title: Perhatikan reaksinya
steps.body: Kalau ia menarik tangan atau mengerutkan dahi, hentikan kain itu. Pilihannya sudah jelas.

id.parent_tip: Dua tekstur cukup untuk satu sesi. Lebih dari itu dan tidak ada yang benar-benar dirasakan.
id.safety_notes: Hanya gunakan kain bersih, tanpa benang lepas, tanpa hiasan, dan tidak berbulu halus. Jangan biarkan kain menutupi wajah bayi.
variations: Sentuhkan ke telapak kaki, yang biasanya lebih sensitif.
Letakkan satu kain di tangannya dan biarkan ia menggenggam sendiri.
id.materials_text: Dua sampai tiga kain bersih dengan tekstur berbeda

en.title: Safe Texture Cloths
en.summary: Touch two or three different fabrics to your baby's hands and feet, one at a time.
en.learning_goal: Introduces different textures through the skin, a baby's first way into understanding objects.

steps.title: Prepare two or three cloths
steps.body: Pick clearly different ones: smooth cotton, a rough towel, a knitted weave. Make sure they are all clean.

steps.title: Start at the hands
steps.body: Stroke the first cloth gently over the back of their hand while naming it: "soft".

steps.title: Give them time to feel it
steps.body: Hold it in one spot for a few seconds before moving. Babies need time to process touch.

steps.title: Switch to a different cloth
steps.body: Use the second on the same hand, with a different word: "rough". A back-to-back contrast is the easiest to notice.

steps.title: Watch their reaction
steps.body: If they pull their hand away or frown, stop with that cloth. They have told you their preference.

en.parent_tip: Two textures is enough for one session. More than that and none of them really register.
en.safety_notes: Use only clean cloths with no loose threads, no decorations, and no loose fibres. Never let a cloth cover your baby's face.
variations: Try the soles of the feet, which are usually more sensitive.
Place one cloth in their hand and let them grip it themselves.
en.materials_text: Two or three clean cloths with different textures

id.title: Satu Lagu, Setiap Malam
id.summary: Pilih satu lagu pendek, dan nyanyikan lagu yang sama setiap malam sebelum tidur.
id.learning_goal: Membangun penanda tidur yang bisa diprediksi, dan memberi bayi pengalaman irama bahasa.

steps.title: Pilih satu lagu dan tetap pakai itu
steps.body: Lagu apa pun yang Anda hafal. Yang penting lagunya tidak berganti, karena pengulangannya yang bekerja.

steps.title: Redupkan lampu dulu
steps.body: Kurangi cahaya dan suara di ruangan sebelum mulai. Lingkungan ikut jadi bagian penanda.

steps.title: Gendong dan goyang pelan
steps.body: Gendong bayi dekat dada Anda. Goyangan lambat dan teratur, bukan diayun kencang.

steps.title: Nyanyikan pelan dan lambat
steps.body: Setengah dari kecepatan normal. Suara Anda lebih menenangkan daripada rekaman apa pun.

steps.title: Letakkan ia saat masih mengantuk, belum tertidur
steps.body: Baringkan telentang di tempat tidurnya sendiri sambil masih setengah sadar.

id.parent_tip: Anda tidak perlu bisa menyanyi. Bayi mengenali suara Anda, bukan kualitas nadanya.
id.safety_notes: Tidurkan bayi selalu telentang, di permukaan rata, tanpa bantal, selimut tebal, atau mainan di dalam tempat tidurnya.
variations: Hum saja tanpa kata kalau Anda sudah terlalu lelah untuk bernyanyi.
Gunakan lagu yang berbeda untuk siang dan malam, supaya dua rutinitas terpisah.

en.title: One Song, Every Night
en.summary: Pick one short song and sing that same song every night before sleep.
en.learning_goal: Builds a predictable sleep signal, and gives your baby the rhythm of language.

steps.title: Choose one song and stick with it
steps.body: Any song you know by heart. What matters is that it doesn't change, because the repetition is what works.

steps.title: Dim the lights first
steps.body: Lower the light and noise in the room before you begin. The setting becomes part of the signal.

steps.title: Hold and sway slowly
steps.body: Hold your baby close to your chest. A slow, steady sway, never a vigorous rock.

steps.title: Sing quietly and slowly
steps.body: At about half your normal speed. Your voice is more settling than any recording.

steps.title: Put them down drowsy, not asleep
steps.body: Lay them on their back in their own sleep space while they are still half awake.

en.parent_tip: You don't need to be able to sing. Your baby recognises your voice, not your pitch.
en.safety_notes: Always put a baby to sleep on their back, on a flat surface, with no pillow, thick blanket, or toys in their sleep space.
variations: Just hum if you are too tired to sing.
Use a different song for daytime naps, so the two routines stay separate.

id.title: Genggam Jari Ayah Ibu
id.summary: Letakkan jari Anda di telapak bayi, dan main tarik-tahan dengan sangat lembut.
id.learning_goal: Memperkuat genggaman dan mengenalkan permainan bergiliran lewat sentuhan.

steps.title: Buka telapaknya dengan sabar
steps.body: Usap punggung tangan bayi dengan jari. Telapaknya biasanya akan membuka sendiri.

steps.title: Masukkan satu jari
steps.body: Letakkan telunjuk Anda di telapaknya. Ia akan menggenggam, itu refleks alami.

steps.title: Tarik sangat sedikit
steps.body: Tarik jari Anda sedikit saja sehingga ia merasa ada tahanan ringan. Jangan sampai badannya terangkat.

steps.title: Sebut apa yang terjadi
steps.body: Katakan "pegang" saat ia menggenggam dan "lepas" saat ia melepaskan. Kata menempel pada pengalaman.

steps.title: Ulangi dengan tangan yang lain
steps.body: Beri kedua tangan kesempatan yang sama.

id.parent_tip: Genggaman bayi baru sangat kuat tapi tidak disengaja. Jangan tarik untuk mengangkatnya, sendi bahunya belum siap.
id.safety_notes: Jangan pernah menarik bayi dari tangannya untuk mengangkat atau mengayunkannya. Risiko cedera sendi bahu dan siku nyata.
variations: Lakukan dengan telapak kaki, yang juga punya refleks menggenggam.
Nyanyikan satu bait pendek sambil bergantian tangan.

en.title: Hold My Finger
en.summary: Put your finger in your baby's palm and play a very gentle hold-and-release game.
en.learning_goal: Strengthens their grip and introduces turn-taking through touch.

steps.title: Open their palm patiently
steps.body: Stroke the back of their hand with your finger. The palm usually opens on its own.

steps.title: Offer one finger
steps.body: Rest your index finger in their palm. They will grip it, which is a natural reflex.

steps.title: Pull back a tiny amount
steps.body: Draw your finger back just enough that they feel a light resistance. Never enough to lift their body.

steps.title: Name what is happening
steps.body: Say "hold" as they grip and "let go" as they release. The word sticks to the experience.

steps.title: Repeat with the other hand
steps.body: Give both hands an equal turn.

en.parent_tip: A newborn's grip is strong but involuntary. Never pull on it to lift them; their shoulder joints are not ready.
en.safety_notes: Never lift or swing a baby by their hands or arms. The risk of shoulder and elbow injury is real.
variations: Try the soles of the feet, which also have a grasp reflex.
Sing a short verse while alternating hands.
